Name: Hide SMAPI Terminal (Windows)
Author: Sam2451
Description:
[size=4]# SMAPI Silent Launcher

[/size][size=3]Tired of the terminal/command prompt window that appears every time you launch Stardew Valley with SMAPI?
This lightweight launcher starts SMAPI silently in the background, so only the game window appears.[/size][size=4]
[/size][size=4]
## Features
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]No terminal/CMD window on launch[/size]
[*][size=3]Fully compatible with Steam and GOG (achievements, overlay, playtime tracking,... all work)[/size]
[*][size=3]Tiny and lightweight - no dependencies[/size]
[*][size=3][b][u]Only works on Windows[/u][/b][/size]
[/list]
[size=4]## How it works[/size]
[size=3]The executable (.exe) is a batch file (.bat) converted to exe and uses a temporary VBScript file to launch StardewModdingAPI.exe on a hidden terminal.[/size]
[size=3]If you are curious (or worried) you can check the .txt file I uploaded of the .bat file I converted to .exe, by using a simple text editor you can see its inner workings.
[/size]
[size=4]## Installation

[/size][size=3]### Steam
[/size][list=1]
[*][size=3]Place SMAPILauncher.exe (you can rename it if you want) in your Stardew Valley folder (same folder as StardewModdingAPI.exe)[/size]
[*][size=3]In Steam, right-click Stardew Valley -> Properties -> General -> Launch Options[/size]
[*][size=3]Replace "Your SMAPI API Filepath" %command% (Default: "C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\StardewModdingAPI.exe" %command%) and change \StardewModdingAPI.exe to \SMAPILauncher.exe[/size]
[/list]
[size=3]### GOG[/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=3]Place SMAPILauncher.exe (you can rename it if you want) in your Stardew Valley folder (same folder as StardewModdingAPI.exe)[/size]
[*][size=3]Point GOG Galaxy to SMAPILauncher.exe instead of [size=3]StardewModdingAPI.exe[/size][/size]
[/list]

[size=4]##Notes
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]The text file (.txt) of the batch file used to create the executable (.exe) is included for transparency[/size]
[*][size=3]Dose not modify SMAPI or the base game in any way[/size]
[*][size=3]All mod functionality, logging to file, and achievements remain fully intact[/size]
[*][size=3]It [size=3]might alert[/size] some antivirus programs and flag the executable as a threat, but that is because the techniques used are also often used by malwares[/size]
[*][size=3]If you encounter any problems or have any suggestions, let me know[/size]
[/list][size=3]
I hope that is useful for someone and have fun with the game!
[/size]
